props.title: Why the answer appears word by word
props.answer:
Soft rain taps the window,
silver threads on grey,
the street hums a quiet song
and puddles hold the day.
notes: each piece appears as soon as it's predicted
no waiting for the whole answer

steps.text: Ask a chatbot a short question. Count the seconds until the first word appears.
Now ask for a long essay. Does the first word appear any later?

segments.title: Myth vs reality: does it search the internet?

props.myth: It searches the internet for the answer
props.reality: It writes from patterns it learned in training. Some apps can add a web search, but that's an extra tool.
